body: Vertical 9:16 candid photograph of a fictional 30-year-old East Asian woman taking a high-angle selfie in a tidy bedroom. Camera held in her outstretched hand above her head, looking down with a natural 20mm wide-angle perspective. Her whole figure remains visible. She wears an opaque loose blue cotton button-up shirt, beige straight-leg trousers, and white sneakers. Dark brown shoulder-length hair, relaxed friendly expression. Light oak floor, cream curtains, a neatly made white bed at the edge of the scene. Soft diffuse ceiling light, natural contact shadows beneath the sneakers, realistic fabric and skin texture, subtle film grain. Everyday lifestyle photography, no glamour styling, no text or watermark.
